market.what: Dielectric immersion fluids for data centers + crypto, world
market.method: est. bottom-up ~1.5 GW/yr new immersion (~$1.0B systems) x ~7 L/kW x ~$15/L = ~$160M + 2-phase fluids ($80-200/L) and top-ups; reports say $0.8-2.4B but include EV/industrial

value.logic: if blend gives 2-phase-like cooling w/o PFAS: ~4 GW immersion 2030 (est.) x 0.03 PUE x 8,760 h x $0.08/kWh = ~$84M + ~0.4 GW 2-phase x 5 L/kW x ~$100/L saved / 5 yr = ~$40M
value.revenue_logic: 2032 fluid market ~$1.2B (22%/yr) x ~3% share; blend made by toll blender
value.margin_logic: blend of bought base stocks; specialty but volume-priced ($15-25/L)

trend.drivers: 3M Novec/Fluorinert exit end-2025; AI rack density; immersion systems ~$1.0B (2025) to ~$3.2B (2030)
trend.deadline: EU universal PFAS restriction decision ~2026-27; Minnesota PFAS-in-products ban 2032

competition.notes: Oil majors dominate single-phase; Chemours leads 2-phase (HFO-based, still fluorinated); ZutaCore moving to Opteon SF33 interim. True non-fluorinated 2-phase fluid still in R&D. ZutaCore $100M Series C (2026).

lab.synth: catalog: blend of bought hydrocarbons/esters/ethers; 3 blend variants
lab.test: ASTM D877/D1816 dielectric breakdown, ASTM D92 flash point, ASTM D445 viscosity, thermal conductivity, boiling point; material compat soak; Intertek/SGS or univ.
lab.logic: 1-2 wk buy+blend + 4-5 wk tests and compat soak; ~$1-2k chemicals + 3 blends x ~$2-3k test panel (est.) + ~$5k compat

sale.gates: tank OEM (Submer, GRC, LiquidStack) + server OEM warranty sign-off ~1 yr; pilot tank 6-12 mo; SDS/REACH
